name: grpc-dotnet (Kestrel)
description: Official .NET reference gRPC implementation on Kestrel (Grpc.AspNetCore)

upstream_pin.notes: NuGet latest stable at pin time; harness pins the exact package version and net9.0 TFM

server.description: SB-18 grpc-dotnet interop server (tests/interop/grpc-dotnet; followup, not yet in tree)

transport_contract.mechanism: KestrelServerOptions: Http2 InitialConnection/StreamWindowSize 16 MiB, MaxStreamsPerConnection 256, Socket NoDelay; see bench/stack-matrix/peers/__init__.py

client.reason: No open-loop client driver for grpc-dotnet; optional client cells are not_run. Server cells use the native generator.

tls.plan: Harness serves the in-tree PEM test PKI (--tls-cert/--tls-key) via X509Certificate2.CreateFromPemFile with a CipherSuitesPolicy pinning TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256; the native generator verifies with ca.crt and server name localhost.
